provenance.candidate_policy: all eligible strictly prior-sale SKUs; no retrieved shortlist

enrichment_normalization.history_age_source: recomputed from seq_purchase_dates and prediction_day: age/(age+90)
enrichment_normalization.stage2_vs_stage1_month_note: Stage 2 retains all 41 pairwise/context features (including month_sin and month_cos, so 10 candidate context columns are shifted from [-1,1] to [0,1]), whereas Stage 1 repeat-no-month-v1 uv_45 omits month_sin and month_cos.
enrichment_normalization.history_text_behavior: Normal Stage 2 slates pass seq_product_text=None with catalog_text_embeddings=None, so product_text_proj receives zero vectors and contributes only its learned bias.

feature_contract.missing: never flags; missing metadata yields zero
feature_contract.statistics_policy: strictly earlier observed purchases (< as_of_date) across train and prior validation months; fixed train-fitted popularity normalization; never same-date/future or held-out test
feature_contract.product_embedding_policy: demand disabled, explicit model/catalogue version refresh

limitations: Single seed and historical CatBoost hyperparameters; no claim of optimal CatBoost tuning.
Training samples negatives with inverse-probability weights; validation scores every eligible SKU.
Model has 52 categorical/statistical features, no text or learned representations.
Comparison changes candidate policy and objective as well as model family.
Query/statistical caches retain historical metadata and train-fitted normalization assumptions.
